result.summary: Refactors CI build scripts to explicitly specify build targets like 'all' or 'all deploy' rather than implicitly appending 'all' based on GOAL conditions. It also switches BUILD_TARGETS parsing to an eval-based string-to-argv conversion to avoid disabling shellcheck SC2086.
result.problem: CI scripts implicitly append 'all' to build targets unless GOAL is 'all' or contains 'codegen', which is non-obvious and confusing when reading CI configurations. Furthermore, handling BUILD_TARGETS required suppressing shellcheck SC2086 warnings.
evidence: Commit fa5643ff99: '"all" is added to the build targets unless GOAL is "all" or contains "codegen". This implicit translation can be confusing, so explicitly spell out the targets as "all", "all deploy", etc., where needed.'
result.scope_notes: Touches CI configuration and shell scripts across 12 files.
result.card: Refactors CI build scripts to explicitly declare build targets rather than relying on implicit logic that appends 'all'. It also adjusts argument expansion for BUILD_TARGETS to avoid suppressing shellcheck warnings. This solves script readability issues and CI linting workarounds for developers maintaining CI scripts. No external dependencies are noted.

risk.why: Mistakes would cause CI jobs to fail to build intended targets or fail CI runs.
